hypotheses.justification: `Matrix.stdBasis` only requires `[Fintype m]`, `[Finite n]`, and `[Semiring K]`; its `dualBasis` is available because `m × n` is finite. Neither `Module.Basis.dualBasis_apply` nor `matrixStdBasis_repr` requires decidable equality. Thus the identity remains provable without this instance.
